params.name: elementName
params.description: Name of the child element to get

params.name: index
params.description: Index number (among same-named children) of the element to get

params.name: elementValue
params.description: Receives the value of the found element

params.name: attrNames
params.description: Receives the names of the found element's attributes

params.name: attrValues
params.description: Receives the values of the found element's attributes

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the reference of a child element identified by name and index, optionally along with its value and attribute name/value arrays.

constraints: elementName matching is case-sensitive by default (XML compliance); configurable via the 'XML DOM case sensitivity' selector of XML SET OPTIONS.
attrNames/attrValues arrays are automatically created and sized by the command if passed.
